dropzone.title: Drop a video here
dropzone.subtitle: or click to browse · MP4, WebM, MOV · nothing is uploaded, ever
dropzone.sizeHint: Up to {max} per file. Larger videos are slow in a browser; trim them first.

info.unreadable: This video can't be decoded by your browser. Try MP4 (H.264) or WebM.

trim.label: Trim range
trim.hint: Drag the handles on the timeline or type exact times.
trim.copyHint: Trimming alone copies the video without re-encoding, so it's fast and lossless.

convert.copyNote: Compatible streams are copied, so converting is usually instant.
convert.transcodeNote: The video will be re-encoded with {codec}.

gif.maxNote: GIFs are capped at {seconds} s. Trim to the part you want.

audio.mp3Note: MP3 is encoded with ffmpeg (downloads ~30 MB once).
audio.wavNote: WAV is uncompressed and exported instantly with WebCodecs.
audio.removeNote: The video is copied without its audio track.

crop.hint: Drag the box or its corners on the player.

frame.hint: Scrub the player to the frame you want, then save it as an image.

engine.fallbackNote: This browser can't encode with WebCodecs; using ffmpeg instead (slower).

status.processedIn: Processed on this device in {seconds} s

recorder.title: Screen & webcam recorder
recorder.subtitle: Recordings stay in this tab until you download them.
recorder.micHint: Mixes your mic into the recording
recorder.permission: Permission denied or no device found.
recorder.unsupported: Recording isn't supported in this browser.
